test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 10 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Q, R, and S are sitting in a straight line facing south. U, W, and X are sitting in a parallel line facing north. Q is sitting to the immediate left of S and opposite to W. R who is opposite to U, is to the immediate right of S. Who sits to the immediate right of U?
solution:
Given: Q, R, and S are sitting in a straight line facing south.

U, W, and X are sitting in a parallel line facing north.

1) Q is sitting to the immediate left of S and opposite to W.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/26cf7c4fd4c5cbb192c6339f7ef272ecca9285c2b766511ac266f05b60c31bee.png] 

2) R who is opposite to U, is to the immediate right of S.

And, X will sit at the remaining place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/029bc308e06a39049259b0bf26a8b0194b22436dca42b25782b2336d710cd7b0.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/029bc308e06a39049259b0bf26a8b0194b22436dca42b25782b2336d710cd7b0.pn
g] 

So, 'X' sits to the immediate right of U.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**.
